# Apiko

> > Custom software development company specializing in SaaS, mobile apps, AI solutions, and digital transformation using React, Node.js, and modern cloud technologies.

Apiko is a software engineering firm led by Mykola Striletskyi with offices in Ukraine and Estonia. They serve industries including fintech, logistics, construction, and healthcare with expertise in React Native, TypeScript, and AI-powered solutions.

## Key Topics

- Custom Software Development
- SaaS Development
- Mobile Development (React Native, iOS, Android)
- AI Development & Integration
- Digital Transformation
- Marketplace Development
- React & Next.js
- Node.js & TypeScript
- Quality Assurance & Testing
- MVP Development
- Fintech Solutions
- UI/UX Design
- Cloud & DevOps (AWS)
- Software Modernization
- Construction & AEC Industry Solutions
